Parts.Description: Midnight flagstones with star-white inlays, a gold zodiac ring around the Eternal Shiba's dais and gold circles on the plazas.
Parts.Name: Chrono Plaza

Parts.Description: Three tall gold lamp posts with star-white lanterns that light the walkway.
Parts.Name: Star Lamps

Parts.Description: A midnight-blue signboard in a gold frame with a golden clock, on two brass posts.
Parts.Name: Time Signpost

Parts.Description: Brass and gold cogwheels of every size, half sunk into the plaza like a garden of turning flowers.
Parts.Name: Cog Garden

Parts.Description: Two stone benches with gold legs and midnight backrests, each with a little clock.
Parts.Name: Sandglass Benches

Parts.Description: Twelve standing stones in a circle mark the hours around a gold sun slab.
Parts.Name: Hour Stones

Parts.Description: Three glass hourglasses with golden sand stand on stone pedestals.
Parts.Name: Sand Timers

Parts.Description: A brass frame holds a long golden pendulum with a big round bob, always swinging in the mind's eye.
Parts.Name: Pendulum Frame

Parts.Description: Nested gold rings turn around a violet core on a brass column.
Parts.Name: Astrolabe

Parts.Description: Three tall dark-wood grandfather clocks with gold heads and star-white faces.
Parts.Name: Grandfather Clocks

Parts.Description: Three dark obelisks with golden capstones that point at the stars.
Parts.Name: Star Obelisks

Parts.Description: A two-tier stone fountain with a brass gear on top and two cogs turning at its sides.
Parts.Name: Gear Fountain

Parts.Description: Three gold poles carry midnight banners with a golden clock sign.
Parts.Name: Time Banners

Parts.Description: A tiny walnut cottage with a gold roof, a clock on the gable and a little bird in the window.
Parts.Name: Cuckoo House

Parts.Description: A still pond of deep blue water with a gold rim and floating gold clocks.
Parts.Name: Starlight Pond

Parts.Description: A tall wheel of the twelve signs turns on a brass stand: gold rim, midnight face and a golden hub.
Parts.Name: Zodiac Wheel

Parts.Description: Six rune pillars with gold caps stand round a gold seal; a small star floats above it.
Parts.Name: Rune Circle

Parts.Description: Two stone pillars and a gold lintel form a gate over the walkway, crowned by a huge turning cog.
Parts.Name: Cog Gate

Parts.Description: Three golden bells of different sizes hang from a brass arch and ring out the hours.
Parts.Name: Chime Bells

Parts.Description: A brass automaton guards the plaza: a clock in its chest, a cog on its back and a starry eye.
Parts.Name: Clockwork Sentinel

Parts.Description: A broad stone dial with twelve hour marks and a golden gnomon that casts the hours across the plaza.
Parts.Name: Giant Sundial

Parts.Description: A three-tier pearl dais carries the golden throne of time, with a clock halo behind it and two star pillars.
Parts.Name: Eternal Throne

Parts.Description: A golden sun on a brass column with two gold orbit rings and five little planets.
Parts.Name: Celestial Orrery

Parts.Description: A brass engine house with giant meshing gears on its front, copper pipes and a chimney: the heart of time.
Parts.Name: Mainspring Engine

Parts.Description: The foot of the Clock Tower: a pearl plinth, a stepped midnight hall with a gold door and corner pillars.
Parts.Name: Clock Base

Parts.Description: A tall midnight shaft with gold bands, pearl corner ribs and star-white windows.
Parts.Name: Tower Shaft

Parts.Description: The big clock case with a white face and a gold bezel on all four sides, topped by a stepped roof and a golden needle.
Parts.Name: Clock Face

Parts.Description: Long gold hour and minute hands on every face, always showing ten past ten.
Parts.Name: Clock Hands

Parts.Description: A huge ring of brass cogs floats around the tower, with small gold gears circling above it.
Parts.Name: Gear Ring

Parts.Description: A gold-framed hourglass of star-white sand floats high above the tower, the last grains falling forever.
Parts.Name: Floating Hourglass
